tees.name: Cool Moo
tees.quote: No rush. The grass isn't going anywhere.

tees.name: Toot
tees.quote: I remember your birthday. And your snack order.

tees.name: Mimi
tees.quote: I wasn't waiting for you. I just happened to be here. For an hour.

tees.name: Blu
tees.quote: You're back! It's been four minutes! Best day ever!

tees.name: Lil Moo
tees.quote: Take half. No wait, take the bigger half.

tees.name: Oki
tees.quote: Why did the banana go to the doctor? It wasn't peeling well.

tees.name: Pip
tees.quote: Last one in is a tadpole!

tees.name: Dax
tees.quote: I never look back. Wait, did I forget my hat?

tees.name: Flap
tees.quote: Watch me fly! ...Almost.

tees.name: Wiggle
tees.quote: My tail has opinions, and it loves you.

tees.name: Slurp
tees.quote: I tried it. I'd try it again. What was it?

tees.name: Bun
tees.quote: Boing! Boing! Sorry, I can't stop.

tees.name: Twirl
tees.quote: I have an idea! Wait, a better idea! Wait...

tees.name: Gem
tees.quote: Good morning! It's very early! I'm so happy!

tees.name: Pling
tees.quote: You liked my picture? Me? Hello!

tees.name: Jab
tees.quote: Fist bump? Gently, please. I'm all gloves.

tees.name: Lumo
tees.quote: Don't worry about the dark. I brought a glow.

tees.name: Fang
tees.quote: Boo! Did it work? Tell me it worked.

tees.name: Zig
tees.quote: Ha ha ha ha ha! That's five funny things at once!

tees.name: Fizz
tees.quote: Wow! Did you see that? Neither did I! Wow!

tees.name: Uno
tees.quote: I only have one eye, so I look extra hard.

tees.name: Bo
tees.quote: What is a door? No, really.

tees.name: Razz
tees.quote: Pffft. That one was for Monday.

tees.name: Tripp
tees.quote: I didn't peek. My spare eye did.

tees.name: Shady
tees.quote: It's not dark. It's just my look.

tees.name: Heli
tees.quote: Today's the day. I can feel it. Maybe tomorrow.

tees.name: Chili
tees.quote: Who did that to you? I'm already furious.

tees.name: Giggle
tees.quote: Sorry! Hehe! It's not funny! Hahaha!

tees.name: Smooch
tees.quote: I love you. And you. And that chair.

tees.name: Plop
tees.quote: Everything starts with a plop.

tees.name: Oops
tees.quote: I didn't mean to. Whatever that was.

tees.name: Whizz
tees.quote: Bzzz! You didn't see me. Bzzz! Still didn't.

tees.name: Stinker
tees.quote: It was me. Hehe. I'd do it again.

tees.name: Twister
tees.quote: Hold on to your hat. And the table.

tees.name: Burp
tees.quote: Excuse me. And you. And you again.

tees.name: Drool
tees.quote: I'm not drooling. I'm thinking about lunch.

tees.name: Flush
tees.quote: Ahem. Bow to the throne, or just wave.

tees.name: Ogle
tees.quote: I'm not staring. Bleh. Okay, I'm staring.

tees.name: Spark
tees.quote: Zing! Wish granted. Oh, wrong wish.

tees.name: Hiya
tees.quote: Hiya! I said it first! I always say it first!

tees.name: Jay
tees.quote: Guess what! Never mind, you already heard.

tees.name: Penny
tees.quote: Heads, I'm lucky. Tails, I'm still lucky.

tees.name: Swoon
tees.quote: Is that a spoon? It's the best spoon ever.

tees.name: Snicker
tees.quote: I just thought of that joke from Tuesday.

tees.name: Chomp
tees.quote: Nom! That was a hug, I swear.

tees.name: Buck
tees.quote: I wasn't gnawing. I was just thinking about it.

tees.name: Snag
tees.quote: I've been right behind you the whole time.

tees.name: Mo
tees.quote: I have a moustache. Therefore I am correct.

tees.name: Pout
tees.quote: Darling, you look wonderful. Everything does.

collections.name: Lovelings
collections.tagline: Round animals with a heart on their face and their tongue out.

collections.name: Joylings
collections.tagline: The silly ones. Each has one odd thing and sees nothing strange about it.

collections.name: Monsterlings
collections.tagline: Small monsters who were meant to be scary. It did not work.

collections.name: PeepPops
collections.tagline: Fuzzy creatures with too many eyes, or just one. They see everything.

collections.name: UniPops
collections.tagline: One horn, one feeling, turned all the way up.

collections.name: Poopies
collections.tagline: What is left when the day is done. Very relaxed about it.

collections.name: POPeyes
collections.tagline: Little suns with one big eye and white gloves that never stop waving.
